parameters.command:
=#!/bin/sh
set -e
echo "=== ✂️ AI Clipper v2 — Run ID: {{ $json.run_id }} ==="
echo "Mode: {% if $json.isRevision %}REVISION (clip {{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}, iteration {{ $json.iteration }}){% else %}FRESH JOB{% endif %}"
echo "URL: {{ $json.youtube_url }}"
echo "Clips requested: {{ $json.clip_count }}"

export CHANNEL_WATERMARK='{{ $json.watermark }}'
{% if $json.isRevision %}
export CLIP_REVISION_TARGET={{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}
export CLIP_REVISION_INSTRUCTIONS='{{ $json.revisionInstructions.replace(/'/g, '').slice(0, 300) }}'
echo "Revision target: clip {{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}"
echo "Instructions: $CLIP_REVISION_INSTRUCTIONS"

# Only remove the specific clip being revised, keep others
rm -f /workspace/clips/vertical_clip_{{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}.mp4
rm -f /workspace/clips/_raw_{{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}.mp4
rm -f /workspace/clips/_subs_{{ $json.revisionClipIndex }}.srt
{% else %}
# Fresh job — clean all clips
rm -f /workspace/clips/vertical_clip_*.mp4
rm -f /workspace/clips/_*.mp4
rm -f /workspace/clips/_*.srt
{% endif %}
rm -f /workspace/clips/metadata.json

CLIPPER="/workspace/03-ai-clipping/scripts/local_clipper_v2.py"
if [ ! -f "$CLIPPER" ]; then
  CLIPPER="/workspace/local_clipper_v2.py"
fi

python3 "$CLIPPER" \
  '{{ $json.youtube_url }}' \
  {{ $json.clip_count }}

echo "=== ✅ Script Complete ==="
ls -lh /workspace/clips/vertical_clip_*.mp4 2>/dev/null || echo 'No clips found'
cat /workspace/clips/metadata.json
